<script>
/**
 * wbm-import.js —— 世界书 JSON 运行时解析器（纯函数，无 DOM / sdk 依赖）。
 * 与 build_wb_monitor.py 的归一化逻辑对齐，搬到 JS 里在沙盒 iframe 中运行。
 * 产出 window.__WBM_IMPORT__，供 wbm-runtime.js 调用。
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__WBM_IMPORT__) return;

  // position 字符串 -> 数字（卡内 character_book 方言）
  var POS_STR = {
    before_char: 0, after_char: 1, before_author_note: 2, after_author_note: 3,
    at_depth: 4, before_example: 5, after_example: 6,
    before_char_defs: 0, after_char_defs: 1, before_AN: 2, after_AN: 3
  };

  // 关键词字段方言归一：MMD 导出的 key/keysecondary 可能是 JSON 字符串。
  function parseKeys(raw) {
    if (raw == null) return [];
    if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
      var a = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) if (raw[i]) a.push(String(raw[i]));
      return a;
    }
    if (typeof raw === 'string') {
      var s = raw.trim();
      if (!s || s === '[]' || s === 'null' || s === '""') return [];
      try {
        var v = JSON.parse(s);
        if (Array.isArray(v)) {
          var b = [];
          for (var j = 0; j < v.length; j++) if (v[j]) b.push(String(v[j]));
          return b;
        }
      } catch (e) {}
      return raw ? [raw] : [];
    }
    return [];
  }

  function toInt(x, def) {
    if (x == null) return def;
    var n = parseInt(x, 10);
    return isNaN(n) ? def : n;
  }

  // 单条目归一化成 tuple：[uid, title, cLen, order, position, depth, prob, keys[], keys2[]]
  // 返回 null 表示跳过（禁用）。
  function normalizeEntry(item, idx) {
    if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') return null;

    // 启停：独立世界书 disable；卡内 enabled（语义相反）
    if ('disable' in item) {
      if (item.disable === true) return null;
    } else if ('enabled' in item) {
      if (item.enabled === false) return null;
    }

    var isBlue = !!item.constant;
    var uid = (item.uid != null) ? item.uid : ((item.id != null) ? item.id : idx);
    var title = String(item.comment || item.title || item.name || '未命名');
    var cLen = (typeof item.content === 'string') ? item.content.length : 0;
    var order = toInt(item.order != null ? item.order : item.insertion_order, 0);
    var pos = item.position;
    if (typeof pos === 'string') pos = (POS_STR[pos] != null) ? POS_STR[pos] : 4;
    if (pos == null) pos = 4;
    var depth = toInt(item.depth, 0);
    var prob = item.probability == null ? 100 : toInt(item.probability, 100);

    var keys = parseKeys(item.key != null ? item.key : item.keys);
    var keys2 = parseKeys(item.keysecondary != null ? item.keysecondary : item.secondary_keys);

    if (isBlue) return [uid, title, cLen, order, pos, depth, prob, [], []];
    return [uid, title, cLen, order, pos, depth, prob, keys, keys2];
  }

  // 顶层解析：支持 ① entries 数组/dict（ST 独立世界书）② character_book.entries（v2 卡）
  function buildSnapshot(data, name) {
    var entries = null;
    if (Array.isArray(data)) entries = data;
    else if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
      if ('entries' in data) entries = data.entries;
      else if (data.character_book && data.character_book.entries) entries = data.character_book.entries;
    }
    if (entries == null) return null;

    var items = [];
    if (Array.isArray(entries)) {
      items = entries;
    } else if (typeof entries === 'object') {
      for (var k in entries) {
        if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(entries, k) && typeof entries[k] === 'object') {
          items.push(entries[k]);
        }
      }
    }

    var blues = [], greens = [], i, e;
    for (i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
      e = normalizeEntry(items[i], i);
      if (!e) continue;
      if (items[i].constant === true) blues.push(e); else greens.push(e);
    }

    // 展示/填充顺序：order 升序（与 Python 构建器 build_snapshot 一致）
    blues.sort(function (a, b) { return a[3] - b[3]; });
    greens.sort(function (a, b) { return a[3] - b[3]; });

    var blueChars = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < blues.length; i++) blueChars += blues[i][2];

    return {
      name: name || '世界书',
      blue: blues,
      green: greens,
      blueChars: blueChars,
      blueCount: blues.length,
      greenCount: greens.length
    };
  }

  window.__WBM_IMPORT__ = {
    parseKeys: parseKeys,
    normalizeEntry: normalizeEntry,
    buildSnapshot: buildSnapshot,
    POS_STR: POS_STR
  };
})();

</script>

<script>
/**
 * wbm-runtime.js —— 世界书触发监视器核心（MMD 沙盒模式）
 * 数据快照 + 复算引擎 + 固定传输预算 + 暗号解析 + 事件采集 + 世界书导入。
 * 不含任何 DOM 渲染，UI 由 wbm-ui.js 消费 window.__WBM_CORE__。
 * 快照三来源：① 内嵌 window.__WBM_SNAP__（可选默认书）② sdk.save 导入书 ③ 运行时导入。
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__WBM_CORE__) return;
  var sdk = window.sdk;
  function dbg() {
    try { if (sdk && sdk.debug && sdk.debug.log) sdk.debug.log.apply(null, ['[WBM]'].concat([].slice.call(arguments))); }
    catch (e) {}
  }

  // ============ 快照（可变状态） ============
  var SNAP = null;
  var blues = [];
  var greens = [];
  var byUid = {};
  var byTitle = {};

  function buildIndex() {
    byUid = {}; byTitle = {};
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < blues.length; i++) { var b = blues[i]; b.isBlue = true; byUid[b[0]] = b; byTitle[b[1]] = b; }
    for (i = 0; i < greens.length; i++) { var g = greens[i]; g.isBlue = false; byUid[g[0]] = g; byTitle[g[1]] = g; }
  }
  function applySnapshot(snap) {
    if (!snap || !Array.isArray(snap.green)) return false;
    SNAP = snap;
    blues = SNAP.blue || [];
    greens = SNAP.green || [];
    buildIndex();
    confirmed = {}; lastUserTriggers = [];
    return true;
  }
  function eKeys(e) { return e[7] || []; }
  function eKeys2(e) { return e[8] || []; }

  // ============ 配置 ============
  var CFG_KEY = 'wbm.cfg.v1';
  var cfg = { depth: 2, persona: 0, caseSensitive: false };
  try { var _s = localStorage.getItem(CFG_KEY); if (_s) { var _o = JSON.parse(_s); if (_o) cfg = _o; } } catch (e) {}
  function saveCfg() { try { localStorage.setItem(CFG_KEY, JSON.stringify(cfg)); } catch (e) {} }
  var SAVE_KEY = 'wbm.snapshot.v1';

  // ============ 状态 ============
  var confirmed = {};
  var lastUserTriggers = [];

  // ============ 消息缓冲 ============
  var msgBuf = [];
  var msgSeen = {};
  var BUF_MAX = 60;
  function msgKey(msg) {
    if (msg && msg.serverId != null) return 's:' + msg.serverId;
    if (msg && msg.id != null) return 'i:' + msg.id;
    return null;
  }
  function pushMsg(key, role, text) {
    if (!text) return;
    var t = String(text).trim();
    if (!t) return;
    if (key && msgSeen[key]) return;
    if (key) msgSeen[key] = true;
    msgBuf.push({ key: key, role: role, text: t });
    if (msgBuf.length > BUF_MAX) msgBuf.splice(0, msgBuf.length - BUF_MAX);
  }

  // ============ 匹配引擎 ============
  function hitKeys(text, keys, cs) {
    var t = cs ? text : text.toLowerCase();
    var found = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
      var k = keys[i];
      if (!k) continue;
      var kk = cs ? String(k) : String(k).toLowerCase();
      if (kk && t.indexOf(kk) >= 0) found.push(String(k));
    }
    return found;
  }
  function scanEntry(e, msgs, cs) {
    if (e.isBlue) return { state: 'blue' };
    var win = msgs.slice(-(cfg.depth || 2));
    var text = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < win.length; i++) text += win[i].text + '\n';
    var matched = hitKeys(text, eKeys(e), cs);
    if (matched.length === 0) return { state: 'idle' };
    var k2 = eKeys2(e);
    if (k2 && k2.length && hitKeys(text, k2, cs).length === 0) return { state: 'idle' };
    var prob = e[6];
    var isProb = (typeof prob === 'number' && prob > 0 && prob < 100);
    return { state: isProb ? 'prob' : 'hit', matched: matched, prob: prob };
  }
  function compute() {
    var cs = !!cfg.caseSensitive;
    var res = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < greens.length; i++) {
      var r = scanEntry(greens[i], msgBuf, cs);
      r.entry = greens[i];
      res.push(r);
    }
    return res;
  }

  // ============ 固定传输预算（15000 字） ============
  // 触发顺序（用户实测口径）：order 降序；同 order 字数降序；放不下整条跳过，继续后面。
  var LIMIT = 15000;
  function seqCmp(a, b) {
    if (a[3] !== b[3]) return b[3] - a[3];
    return b[2] - a[2];
  }
  function budgetPass(results) {
    var i, e, r;
    var seq = blues.slice();
    for (i = 0; i < results.length; i++) {
      r = results[i];
      if (r.state === 'hit' || r.state === 'prob') seq.push(r.entry);
    }
    seq.sort(seqCmp);
    var budget = cfg.persona || 0;
    var over = {};
    for (i = 0; i < seq.length; i++) {
      e = seq[i];
      if (budget + e[2] > LIMIT) over[e[0]] = true;
      else budget += e[2];
    }
    var blueChars = 0;
    for (i = 0; i < blues.length; i++) blueChars += blues[i][2];
    var fixed = (cfg.persona || 0) + blueChars;
    var demand = fixed;
    for (i = 0; i < results.length; i++) {
      r = results[i];
      if (r.state === 'hit' || r.state === 'prob') demand += r.entry[2];
    }
    return { over: over, demand: demand, fixed: fixed, blueChars: blueChars };
  }

  // ============ 暗号解析 ============
  function parseMarkers(content) {
    var re = /\[WBM:([^\]]{1,40})\]/g, m, hit = [];
    while ((m = re.exec(content))) {
      var t = (m[1] || '').trim();
      var e = byUid[t] || byTitle[t];
      if (e) hit.push(e[0]);
    }
    return hit;
  }

  // ============ 导入 ============
  function importJson(raw) {
    var data = JSON.parse(raw);   // 抛错由 UI 捕获
    var importer = window.__WBM_IMPORT__;
    if (!importer) throw new Error('解析器未加载');
    var snap = importer.buildSnapshot(data, '世界书');
    if (!snap) throw new Error('未识别到世界书条目');
    if (!applySnapshot(snap)) throw new Error('快照应用失败');
    try { if (sdk && sdk.save && sdk.save.set) sdk.save.set(SAVE_KEY, snap); } catch (e) {}
    return snap;
  }

  function loadInitial() {
    if (sdk && sdk.save && sdk.save.get) {
      try {
        var saved = sdk.save.get(SAVE_KEY);
        if (saved && applySnapshot(saved)) { dbg('从 save 装载世界书', saved.name); return; }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
    if (window.__WBM_SNAP__ && applySnapshot(window.__WBM_SNAP__)) { dbg('从内嵌默认装载世界书'); return; }
    dbg('未装载世界书，等待导入');
  }

  // ============ 重绘订阅 ============
  var _listeners = [];
  function onChange(cb) { _listeners.push(cb); }
  function emit() {
    var results = compute();
    var budget = budgetPass(results);
    for (var i = 0; i < _listeners.length; i++) { try { _listeners[i](results, budget); } catch (e) {} }
  }

  function reset() { confirmed = {}; lastUserTriggers = []; emit(); }

  // ============ 事件 ============
  try {
    sdk.on('message:done', function (msg) {
      if (!msg || !msg.content) return;
      pushMsg(msgKey(msg), msg.role || 'ai', msg.content);
      var hits = parseMarkers(msg.content);
      for (var i = 0; i < hits.length; i++) confirmed[hits[i]] = true;
      emit();
    });
    sdk.on('conversation:switch', function () {
      msgBuf = []; msgSeen = {}; confirmed = {}; lastUserTriggers = []; emit();
    });
    sdk.on('message:mount', function (msg) {
      if (!msg || msg.role !== 'user' || !msg.content) return;
      pushMsg(msgKey(msg), 'user', msg.content);
      lastUserTriggers = [];
      var cs = !!cfg.caseSensitive;
      for (var i = 0; i < greens.length; i++) {
        var r = scanEntry(greens[i], msgBuf, cs);
        if (r.state === 'hit' || r.state === 'prob') lastUserTriggers.push(greens[i][0]);
      }
      emit();
    });
  } catch (e) { dbg('订阅失败', e && e.message); }

  // ============ 暴露接口 ============
  window.__WBM_CORE__ = {
    applySnapshot: applySnapshot,
    importJson: importJson,
    compute: compute,
    budget: budgetPass,
    onChange: onChange,
    emit: emit,
    reset: reset,
    parseMarkers: parseMarkers,
    saveCfg: saveCfg,
    LIMIT: LIMIT,
    get snap() { return SNAP; },
    get blues() { return blues; },
    get greens() { return greens; },
    get byUid() { return byUid; },
    get byTitle() { return byTitle; },
    get confirmed() { return confirmed; },
    get lastUserTriggers() { return lastUserTriggers; },
    get cfg() { return cfg; },
    get msgBuf() { return msgBuf; },
    eKeys: eKeys,
    eKeys2: eKeys2
  };

  loadInitial();
  dbg('核心已装载: 蓝灯', blues.length, '绿灯', greens.length);
})();

</script>

<script>
/**
 * wbm-ui.js —— 世界书触发监视器 UI（MMD 沙盒模式）
 * 侧边栏面板 + 导入界面 + 渲染。依赖 window.__WBM_CORE__（wbm-runtime.js 先行装载）。
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.__WBM_UI_LOADED) return;
  var CORE = window.__WBM_CORE__;
  if (!CORE) return;   // 核心没装载，UI 直接跳过
  window.__WBM_UI_LOADED = true;

  var sdk = window.sdk;
  function dbg() {
    try { if (sdk && sdk.debug && sdk.debug.log) sdk.debug.log.apply(null, ['[WBM-UI]'].concat([].slice.call(arguments))); }
    catch (e) {}
  }

  var panelBuilt = false;
  var open = false;
  try { open = localStorage.getItem('wbm.open') === '1'; } catch (e) {}

  function el(tag, cls, text) {
    var n = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined) n.textContent = text;
    return n;
  }
  function txt(s) { return document.createTextNode(s); }

  function buildPanel() {
    if (panelBuilt) return;
    var root = document.querySelector('[data-chat="root"]') || document.body;
    if (!root) return;

    var st = document.createElement('style');
    st.id = 'wbm-style';
    st.textContent =
      '#wbm-panel{position:fixed;right:10px;top:64px;width:300px;max-height:72vh;z-index:6000;' +
      'display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;' +
      'background:var(--chat-panel-bg,#181a1f);color:var(--chat-text,#e8e6e3);' +
      'box-shadow:0 6px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;' +
      'border:1px solid var(--chat-border,#2a2d34)}' +
      '#wbm-panel.wbm-hidden{display:none}' +
      '#wbm-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 10px;' +
      'background:var(--chat-panel-head-bg,#1f2229);font-weight:600}' +
      '#wbm-x{cursor:pointer;background:none;border:none;color:var(--chat-text-muted,#9aa0a6);font-size:16px}' +
      '#wbm-stats{padding:6px 10px;background:var(--chat-panel-head-bg,#1f2229);border-top:1px solid var(--chat-border,#2a2d34);' +
      'color:var(--chat-text-muted,#9aa0a6);font-size:11px}' +
      '#wbm-body{overflow-y:auto;flex:1}' +
      '.wbm-sec{padding:6px 10px 3px;font-weight:600;color:var(--chat-accent,#c9a86a);position:sticky;top:0;' +
      'background:var(--chat-panel-bg,#181a1f)}' +
      '.wbm-row{padding:3px 10px;cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(128,128,128,.08)}' +
      '.wbm-row:hover{background:rgba(128,128,128,.08)}' +
      '.wbm-dot{display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px}' +
      '.wbm-dot.blue{background:#5b8def}.wbm-dot.conf{background:#3fbf6f}.wbm-dot.hit{background:#e6c14f}' +
      '.wbm-dot.prob{background:#e58b3f}.wbm-dot.idle{background:#5a5e66}.wbm-dot.cut{background:#e5484d}' +
      '.wbm-ord{float:right;color:var(--chat-text-muted,#7a7f86);font-size:10px}' +
      '.wbm-det{display:none;padding:2px 10px 6px;color:var(--chat-text-muted,#9aa0a6);font-size:11px}' +
      '.wbm-det.open{display:block}' +
      '.wbm-now{padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--chat-border,#2a2d34)}' +
      '.wbm-chip{display:inline-block;background:rgba(230,193,79,.15);border:1px solid rgba(230,193,79,.4);' +
      'border-radius:10px;padding:0 6px;margin:1px 2px 1px 0;font-size:10px}' +
      '#wbm-foot{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:6px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--chat-border,#2a2d34);flex-wrap:wrap}' +
      '#wbm-foot input{width:56px;background:var(--chat-input-bg,#14161b);color:var(--chat-text,#e8e6e3);' +
      'border:1px solid var(--chat-border,#2a2d34);border-radius:6px;padding:2px 4px;font-size:11px}' +
      '#wbm-foot button{background:var(--chat-accent,#c9a86a);color:#1a1a1a;border:none;border-radius:6px;' +
      'padding:3px 8px;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}' +
      '#wbm-launcher{position:fixed;right:0;top:46%;z-index:6000;width:26px;height:64px;' +
      'border-radius:8px 0 0 8px;background:var(--chat-accent,#c9a86a);color:#1a1a1a;' +
      'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;' +
      'writing-mode:vertical-rl;letter-spacing:2px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}' +
      '.wbm-import{display:none;padding:8px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--chat-border,#2a2d34)}' +
      '.wbm-import.open{display:block}' +
      '.wbm-import-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--chat-text-muted,#9aa0a6);margin-bottom:4px}' +
      '.wbm-import textarea{width:100%;height:140px;box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--chat-input-bg,#14161b);' +
      'color:var(--chat-text,#e8e6e3);border:1px solid var(--chat-border,#2a2d34);border-radius:6px;' +
      'padding:6px;font-size:11px;resize:vertical;font-family:inherit}' +
      '.wbm-import-btns{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}' +
      '.wbm-import-btns button{flex:1}' +
      '.wbm-import-msg{font-size:11px;margin-top:4px;color:var(--chat-accent,#c9a86a)}' +
      '.wbm-import-msg.err{color:#e5484d}' +
      '.wbm-empty{padding:16px 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--chat-text-muted,#9aa0a6);line-height:1.6}';
    document.head.appendChild(st);

    var panel = el('div', '');
    panel.id = 'wbm-panel';
    panel.className = open ? '' : 'wbm-hidden';

    var head = el('div', ''); head.id = 'wbm-head';
    var titleSpan = el('span', '', '未装载世界书'); titleSpan.id = 'wbm-title';
    head.appendChild(titleSpan);
    var xBtn = el('button', '', '×'); xBtn.id = 'wbm-x';
    xBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { togglePanel(); });
    head.appendChild(xBtn);
    panel.appendChild(head);

    var statsDiv = el('div', ''); statsDiv.id = 'wbm-stats';
    panel.appendChild(statsDiv);
    var bodyDiv = el('div', ''); bodyDiv.id = 'wbm-body';
    panel.appendChild(bodyDiv);

    // 导入弹层
    var imp = el('div', ''); imp.id = 'wbm-import'; imp.className = 'wbm-import';
    var impLabel = el('div', '', '粘贴世界书 JSON，或点「加载文件」选本地文件，也可直接把文件拖到下面文本框里（ST 独立格式或 v2 卡 character_book）:');
    impLabel.className = 'wbm-import-label';
    imp.appendChild(impLabel);
    var impTa = el('textarea', ''); impTa.id = 'wbm-import-ta';
    imp.appendChild(impTa);
    var impBtns = el('div', ''); impBtns.className = 'wbm-import-btns';
    var impLoad = el('button', '', '加载文件'); impLoad.id = 'wbm-import-load';
    var impOk = el('button', '', '导入'); impOk.id = 'wbm-import-ok';
    var impCancel = el('button', '', '取消'); impCancel.id = 'wbm-import-cancel';
    impBtns.appendChild(impLoad); impBtns.appendChild(impOk); impBtns.appendChild(impCancel);
    imp.appendChild(impBtns);
    // 隐藏的 file input（点「加载文件」触发原生文件选择器）
    var impFile = el('input', ''); impFile.id = 'wbm-import-file'; impFile.type = 'file';
    impFile.accept = '.json,application/json,text/plain';
    impFile.style.display = 'none';
    imp.appendChild(impFile);
    var impMsg = el('div', ''); impMsg.id = 'wbm-import-msg'; impMsg.className = 'wbm-import-msg';
    imp.appendChild(impMsg);
    panel.appendChild(imp);

    // 底部设置栏
    var foot = el('div', ''); foot.id = 'wbm-foot';
    var impBtn = el('button', '', '导入世界书'); impBtn.id = 'wbm-import-btn';
    foot.appendChild(impBtn);
    foot.appendChild(el('label', '', '人设字数'));
    var inp1 = el('input', ''); inp1.id = 'wbm-persona'; inp1.type = 'number'; inp1.min = '0';
    foot.appendChild(inp1);
    foot.appendChild(el('label', '', '扫描深度'));
    var inp2 = el('input', ''); inp2.id = 'wbm-depth'; inp2.type = 'number'; inp2.min = '1'; inp2.max = '20';
    foot.appendChild(inp2);
    var rst = el('button', '', '复位');
    rst.addEventListener('click', function () { CORE.reset(); dbg('已复位'); });
    foot.appendChild(rst);
    panel.appendChild(foot);

    var launcher = el('div', ''); launcher.id = 'wbm-launcher'; launcher.textContent = '世界书';
    launcher.addEventListener('click', function () { togglePanel(); });

    root.appendChild(panel);
    root.appendChild(launcher);

    // 输入框初始值 + 监听
    inp1.value = CORE.cfg.persona || 0;
    inp2.value = CORE.cfg.depth || 2;
    inp1.addEventListener('change', function () { CORE.cfg.persona = parseInt(this.value, 10) || 0; CORE.saveCfg(); CORE.emit(); });
    inp2.addEventListener('change', function () { CORE.cfg.depth = parseInt(this.value, 10) || 2; CORE.saveCfg(); CORE.emit(); });

    // 导入交互
    impBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { openImport(); });
    impOk.addEventListener('click', function () { doImport(); });
    impCancel.addEventListener('click', function () { closeImport(); });
    impLoad.addEventListener('click', function () {
      try { impFile.value = ''; impFile.click(); } catch (e) { dbg('file click 失败', e && e.message); }
    });
    impFile.addEventListener('change', function () {
      var f = impFile.files && impFile.files[0];
      if (!f) return;
      readFileText(f, function (text) {
        if (text == null) { setImportMsg('文件读取失败', true); return; }
        var ta2 = document.getElementById('wbm-import-ta');
        if (ta2) ta2.value = text;
        setImportMsg('已载入文件：' + f.name + '（' + text.length + ' 字符），点「导入」生效', false);
      });
    });

    // 文本框拖拽放下文件
    impTa.addEventListener('dragover', function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      ev.stopPropagation();
    });
    impTa.addEventListener('drop', function (ev) {
      ev.preventDefault();
      ev.stopPropagation();
      var files = ev.dataTransfer && ev.dataTransfer.files;
      if (!files || !files.length) return;
      var f = files[0];
      readFileText(f, function (text) {
        if (text == null) { setImportMsg('文件读取失败', true); return; }
        impTa.value = text;
        setImportMsg('已载入文件：' + f.name + '（' + text.length + ' 字符），点「导入」生效', false);
      });
    });

    panelBuilt = true;
    if (open) togglePanel(true);
  }

  function togglePanel(force) {
    var p = document.getElementById('wbm-panel');
    if (!p) return;
    var show = (typeof force === 'boolean') ? force : p.className.indexOf('wbm-hidden') >= 0;
    p.className = show ? '' : 'wbm-hidden';
    open = show;
    try { localStorage.setItem('wbm.open', show ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) {}
    if (show) CORE.emit();
  }

  function openImport() {
    var imp = document.getElementById('wbm-import');
    if (imp) imp.className = 'wbm-import open';
    setImportMsg('', false);
    var ta = document.getElementById('wbm-import-ta');
    if (ta) setTimeout(function () { try { ta.focus(); } catch (e) {} }, 0);
  }
  function closeImport() {
    var imp = document.getElementById('wbm-import');
    if (imp) imp.className = 'wbm-import';
  }
  function setImportMsg(text, isErr) {
    var msg = document.getElementById('wbm-import-msg');
    if (!msg) return;
    msg.textContent = text || '';
    msg.className = isErr ? 'wbm-import-msg err' : 'wbm-import-msg';
  }
  // 用 FileReader 读文本；失败回调传 null（onerror 或无 FileReader）
  function readFileText(file, cb) {
    if (!file) { cb(null); return; }
    if (typeof FileReader !== 'function') { cb(null); return; }
    try {
      var r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = function () { cb(typeof r.result === 'string' ? r.result : null); };
      r.onerror = function () { cb(null); };
      r.readAsText(file, 'utf-8');
    } catch (e) { cb(null); }
  }
  // 共用导入入口：粘贴与读文件都走这里
  function applyRaw(raw) {
    var ta = document.getElementById('wbm-import-ta');
    var txt = (raw == null) ? ((ta && ta.value) || '') : raw;
    var s = String(txt).trim();
    if (!s) { setImportMsg('请先粘贴 JSON 或加载文件', true); return; }
    try {
      var snap = CORE.importJson(s);
      setImportMsg('已导入：蓝灯 ' + snap.blueCount + ' 条 / ' + snap.blueChars + ' 字，绿灯 ' + snap.greenCount + ' 条', false);
      if (ta) ta.value = '';
      closeImport();
      CORE.emit();
      dbg('世界书已导入', snap.name, '蓝灯', snap.blueCount, '绿灯', snap.greenCount);
    } catch (e) {
      setImportMsg('导入失败：' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e), true);
    }
  }
  function doImport() {
    applyRaw(null);
  }

  function rowEl(e, r, budget) {
    var cls, label;
    var cut = !!budget.over[e[0]];
    if (cut) { cls = 'cut'; label = '超限截断'; }
    else if (e.isBlue) { cls = 'blue'; label = '常驻'; }
    else if (CORE.confirmed[e[0]]) { cls = 'conf'; label = '已确证'; }
    else if (r.state === 'hit') { cls = 'hit'; label = '预计触发'; }
    else if (r.state === 'prob') { cls = 'prob'; label = '概率' + r.prob + '%'; }
    else { cls = 'idle'; label = '未触发'; }

    var row = el('div', 'wbm-row');
    row.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var d = row.querySelector('.wbm-det');
      if (d) d.className = d.className.indexOf('open') >= 0 ? 'wbm-det' : 'wbm-det open';
    });
    row.appendChild(el('span', 'wbm-dot ' + cls));
    row.appendChild(txt(e[1]));
    row.appendChild(el('span', 'wbm-ord', label));

    var det = [];
    if (!e.isBlue) {
      var k = CORE.eKeys(e); if (k.length) det.push('关键词: ' + k.join('、'));
      var k2 = CORE.eKeys2(e); if (k2.length) det.push('次关键词(AND): ' + k2.join('、'));
      if (r.matched && r.matched.length) det.push('命中: ' + r.matched.join('、'));
    }
    det.push('字数' + e[2] + ' · 序' + e[3] + ' · 位' + e[4] + ' · 深' + e[5] +
      (typeof e[6] === 'number' && e[6] < 100 ? ' · 概率' + e[6] + '%' : ''));
    if (det.length) row.appendChild(el('div', 'wbm-det', det.join(' | ')));
    return row;
  }

  function render(results, budget) {
    buildPanel();
    var stats = document.getElementById('wbm-stats');
    var body = document.getElementById('wbm-body');
    if (!stats || !body) return;

    var SNAP = CORE.snap;
    var blues = CORE.blues, greens = CORE.greens;

    if (!SNAP) {
      stats.textContent = '未装载世界书';
      while (body.firstChild) body.removeChild(body.firstChild);
      body.appendChild(el('div', 'wbm-empty', '还没有导入世界书。点击下方「导入世界书」粘贴世界书 JSON。'));
      var t = document.getElementById('wbm-title');
      if (t) t.textContent = '未装载世界书';
      return;
    }

    var nConf = 0, nHit = 0, nProb = 0, nOver = 0, i;
    for (i = 0; i < results.length; i++) {
      var st = results[i].state;
      if (st === 'hit') nHit++; else if (st === 'prob') nProb++;
      if (CORE.confirmed[results[i].entry[0]]) nConf++;
    }
    for (i = 0; i < blues.length; i++) if (budget.over[blues[i][0]]) nOver++;
    for (i = 0; i < results.length; i++) if (budget.over[results[i].entry[0]]) nOver++;

    var fixedStr = CORE.cfg.persona > 0 ? (' · 常驻' + budget.fixed + (budget.fixed > CORE.LIMIT ? '(超限!)' : '')) : '';
    var overStr = nOver > 0 ? ' · 截断' + nOver + '条' : '';
    stats.textContent = '蓝灯' + blues.length + '·' + budget.blueChars + '字 · 绿灯' + greens.length +
      ' · 确证' + nConf + '/预计' + nHit + '/概率' + nProb + fixedStr + overStr;

    var t2 = document.getElementById('wbm-title');
    if (t2) t2.textContent = SNAP.name || '世界书';

    while (body.firstChild) body.removeChild(body.firstChild);

    var lt = CORE.lastUserTriggers;
    if (lt.length) {
      var now = el('div', 'wbm-now');
      now.appendChild(txt('本轮触发: '));
      for (i = 0; i < lt.length; i++) {
        var e2 = CORE.byUid[lt[i]];
        now.appendChild(el('span', 'wbm-chip', e2 ? e2[1] : String(lt[i])));
      }
      body.appendChild(now);
    }

    body.appendChild(el('div', 'wbm-sec', '蓝灯·常驻'));
    for (i = 0; i < blues.length; i++) body.appendChild(rowEl(blues[i], { state: 'blue' }, budget));
    body.appendChild(el('div', 'wbm-sec', '绿灯·关键词'));
    for (i = 0; i < results.length; i++) body.appendChild(rowEl(results[i].entry, results[i], budget));
  }

  // 订阅核心重绘
  CORE.onChange(render);

  // 首屏：核心已 loadInitial，等 DOM 就绪后补一次渲染（事件回调里会自然触发，这里兜底）
  setTimeout(function () { try { buildPanel(); CORE.emit(); } catch (e) {} }, 0);

  dbg('UI 已装载');
})();

</script>
